SYMPTOM: Dragged worker gets permanently stuck if mouseup fires outside the canvas element
  CAUSE: onMouseUp on the canvas only fires when mouse is released over the canvas — dragging out and releasing leaves drag state active forever
  FIX: Add window-level mouseup listener in useEffect:
    useEffect(() => {
      const handleWindowMouseUp = (e) => { /* same drop logic */ }
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', handleWindowMouseUp)
      return () => window.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleWindowMouseUp)
    }, [])
  PREVENT: All drag implementations need window-level mouseup, not just element-level
